description: This file defines React functional components related to content display and plan generation for a fitness website. It includes components for listing content, showing detail of a content item, and creating personalized plans, interfacing with an external API.

methods.name: ContentList()
methods.description: Component that fetches and displays a list of content items with a search filter.

methods.name: ContentDetail
methods.description: Component that fetches and displays detailed information about a specific content item based on URL parameter.

methods.name: Plans
methods.description: Component that allows users to select goals and duration, then generate a personalized plan by calling an API.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Async function to generate a new plan based on selected goal and days, updating component state.
